signature: FECIT GEORG NICOLAVS OLLER I R M ZU S HOF UND FELT TRUMETER IN STOCKHOLM 1640 [master’s mark: shield showing a griffin holding a trumpet]
remarks: Excellent condition; heavily restored. 2 tubular slide stays; handle (hexagonal in cross-section) with wooden knob attached to moveable stay; ornate mid-slide stay with open work, 410 from mouthpiece entry, perhaps new work.¹ Ring and plain saddle at slide bow. Slide works well. Ferrules at slide bow have X pattern and scallops at both ends. Two tubular bell stays, lower one becoming flatter on bell-pipe side; lower bell stay has hinge, pin, and eyelet; decoration on both sides of bell stays matches slide stays. Bell bow has no saddle or ring; serpentine-shaped tubing (rather like a double letter “S”) at bell-bow end, with tubular support at extreme end, connecting the two S’s. Possible patch in bell, 43 long, beginning 498 from bell end. Nuremberg-style rim wire; garland has toothed border, with raised dots below teeth; garland has oak leaf pattern with flower. Examined by Carter August 2002
